# Introduction

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Introduction

Remember this valid document structure.

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

    <head>
        <!-- Head Elements -->
    </head>

    <body>
        <!-- Body Elements -->
    </body>

</html>
```

The HTML elements we have learned up until now are all elements that are placed within the <body> tag.

Now we will learn about HTML tags that are usually placed within the <head> tag.

![Structure of HTML elements.](data:image/png;base64,)
